summary: Everyone knows most of this list, and NASA and Modi are fair 'oh right' answers. It runs a bit easy for the 5 to 6 target, and famous names just outside the top 10 (Lady Gaga is #11) eat lives.
reasons: Casual found 8 of 10 in the first 9 guesses, then lost all 5 lives on Kim Kardashian (#13), Lady Gaga (#11), Ariana Grande (unranked), Selena Gomez (#17) and Messi (unranked). Crowd estimate about 6.7, the easy end of the daily band.
Fan swept it in 11 guesses, one life lost on Lady Gaga. Casual Blitz scored 16 of 22 names, so it holds up as Today's Blitz.

Top 10 matches the 14 September 2026 table and every common spelling worked (cr7, modi, riri, beiber, @handles). Small pool problems remain: Messi costs a life though he has no X account, Manchester United is in the pool twice, NASA's full name is not recognized.
fixes: Add 'Lionel Messi' to skip for x-accounts: he comes in through the Instagram and Facebook lists in CELEBRITIES but has no X account, so 'messi' should be free instead of costing a life.

Merge the unranked pool entry 'Manchester United' (from an also table) into #49 Manchester United F.C. and accept 'Manchester United' as its alias: today 'manchester united' offers both, and only the F.C. entry scores in Blitz.
Add 'National Aeronautics and Space Administration' as an alias of #7 NASA: it is not recognized, while the wrong expansion 'National Aeronautics and Space Agency' is.
